mentions.name: Is AI Risk
mentions.description: This web tool analyzes an uploaded CV to assess how big a threat AI poses to the user's career and provides steps on how to reduce that risk. It uses a tuned AI system prompt so the response is neither unnecessarily scary nor too general. Work is ongoing and details will change.
mentions.problem: Workers face uncertainty about how much AI threatens their careers and lack guidance on how to reduce that risk.
mentions.source_excerpt:
How big of a threat is AI to your career? Upload your CV and it will be analyzed. You'll also get steps on how to reduce this risk.

https://www.isairisk.com/

Still working on this and some things will definitely change, but IMO the system prompt is already solid, so that the response isn't unnecessarily scary on one hand, but not too general on the other
